summary: LifeDesk MVP tested end-to-end. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests passed against public URL (seed, dashboard shape, listings, transaction CRUD with balance recompute, transfer neutrality on income/expense, debt payment auto-marking paid, savings deposit increment, bill mark-paid, budget copy, net-worth, global search, reset with HAPUS_SEMUA confirmation and 400 on invalid). Frontend (Expo web, mobile viewport 390x844): dashboard renders hero balance (Rp 38.460.000), 4 tiles, 6-month cashflow chart, upcoming bills, top expenses, recent transactions; bottom tabs (Beranda/Transaksi/Anggaran/Laporan/Lainnya) visible; quick-add expense flow opens modal with type preset, saves via /api/transactions and returns to dashboard; Transaksi screen chips (Semua/Pemasukan/Pengeluaran/Transfer) + search input work; Lainnya menu items navigate to Akun/Kategori/Tagihan/Utang/Target/Catatan/Cari/Backup/Pengaturan (Pengaturan sits behind the bottom tab bar and may need extra bottom padding). No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch).

minor.issue: chart_6m uses `now - i*30 days` which produces non-uniform month steps and can skip/repeat months near month boundaries. Prefer computing month buckets via relativedelta or manual year/month decrement for exactness.
Does not clear the settings collection, so user_name and other settings persist after HAPUS_SEMUA. Product description says reset clears data — decide whether settings should also reset.

apply_debt_payment appends a payment record but does not verify the transaction is actually an expense/transfer to the debt party. Any type carrying debt_id (e.g. income) will still record as a payment and can mark it paid. Consider validating type in {'expense','transfer'} when debt_id is set.
apply_savings_deposit is called regardless of transaction type — an income transaction with savings_goal_id also increments current_amount. Restrict to expense/transfer to a savings account.

ui_bugs.issue: Last menu item 'Pengaturan' is partially hidden behind the bottom tab bar on 390x844 viewport; add ScrollView contentContainerStyle paddingBottom (e.g., 96) so the last row clears the tab bar.

issues: Hero uses white text on green — good contrast. Consider adding a small caret next to 'Akun utama' to hint at tap-through if applicable.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from a react-native-web component prop; migrate any `pointerEvents="..."` prop to `style={{ pointerEvents: '...' }}`. Reference: appears on initial dashboard load.

action_items: Add bottom padding to Lainnya ScrollView so 'Pengaturan' row is not obscured by the tab bar.
Guard apply_debt_payment / apply_savings_deposit against non-expense transaction types.
Fix chart_6m month bucketing to be calendar-accurate (avoid 30-day drift).
Decide + document whether POST /api/reset should also clear settings.
Investigate 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning and migrate to style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 900+ line file — consider splitting into routers per domain (accounts, transactions, budgets, bills, debts, savings) for maintainability.
recompute_account_balance runs a full scan per affected account on every write; acceptable for MVP but consider incremental balance updates for large data sets.
No pagination on GET /api/transactions beyond a fixed limit=500 default; add skip/limit and total count for future scale.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (core flows all pass; one layout nit)

seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seed used (POST /api/seed?force=true) as part of test suite — 5 accounts, 35 transactions, 5 bills, 3 debts, 4 savings, 5 budgets, 4 notes. Tests cleaned up their own TEST_ transactions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Server clock is Aug 2026 (not Jan) — dashboard current-month values reflect August. Use datetime.now(UTC+7).strftime for today when writing month-sensitive tests. All balance/dashboard math verified via create→GET→update→GET→delete→GET pattern. pytest.ini requires xdist; run serially with `-n 0` to avoid worker races on shared DB state (TestReset resets the DB).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs blocking. Minor issues documented above with concrete fixes.
